Class BlockQueue

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<Ray.Intersection<Block>>
java.util.ArrayDeque<Ray.Intersection<Block>>
net.minestom.server.collision.BlockQueue
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Iterable<Ray.Intersection<Block>>, Collection<Ray.Intersection<Block>>, Deque<Ray.Intersection<Block>>, Queue<Ray.Intersection<Block>>, SequencedCollection<Ray.Intersection<Block>>
public final class BlockQueue extends ArrayDeque<Ray.Intersection<Block>>
A modifiable queue for more advanced block raycasts.

Use Ray.blockQueue(Block.Getter) to create.
